quality_notes: Free Allocation rows preserve Authority decisions and consultation response statistics; they are not realised emission reductions.
GGR government-response rows preserve support mechanisms, policy choices and research evidence; potential outputs/jobs are not counted as observed removals.
Waste rows preserve MRV-only scope and monitoring design; voluntary participation is not full UK ETS compliance.
International-maritime historical values are DfT-modelled and cap-adjustment figures are explicitly indicative consultation values, not final measured parcel emissions.
